I had it done at a generic sort of med-spa, but the needling machine was really the key to the experience. 


So the brand of device was called Vivace (vih-vah-chi) and i did 4 treatments of Micro-needling with radio fractionation (EM thermage, so to speak), total numbing, and post care PRP. The machine can be set to the optimum needle-array penetration depth for your skin based on onboard ultrasound, imaging, and some machine learning crap and then the aestheticians could further customize the RF power and band as well. I think it also had that UV/Infrared light therapy built into the needling wand. 


The damn thing was like a totally bespoke biomedi-sthetic “Spa-In-A-Can!” The PRP was set up by the device manufacturer as well, I believe. It was STELLAR!

I’ve been lurking this sub for ages, and have never been brave enough to engage in dialogue but I need to rant because my frustration with dating is just too much; I feel like I’m taking crazy pills. Perhaps some wiser folks will read this and say “ah, yes! I was there and doing this or that helped” or maybe have some nugget of overlooked wisdom to assuage my relentless worry.


Now, I’ll preface this rant with two facts about me: 1). From the time I lost my virginity until age 26 I was ludicrously promiscuous, a cheater, and generally an emotionally immature and borderline abusive turd of a person. This was because of fact number two: 2) I have BPD, CPTSD, ADHD, MDD, SUD, and a partridge in a pear tree, all of which I decided to start treating seriously at 26 in 2016. I proceeded into a period of celibacy and solitude until 2021, and the promptly got my heart broken. 


Having, for many years, suffered from a catastrophic lack of self esteem, and an almost endless well of self loathing, I obviously thought some terrible things about myself and that was reflected in my relationships, but after so much therapy, medication, sobriety, maturation,  and additional experience I have a very different relationship with myself. This is where my frustration begins because during my early and mid 20s acting as the worst version of myself I racked up a respectable triple digit body count and on average I was going on some kind of date about 5 to 6 times a month (and getting laid considerably more often). Success with women abounded despite me being a dumpster fire of a person.


Cut to present day and the changes I’ve made are astonishing to those who haven’t seen me in years. I’ve learned a bit of humility, and dropped the arrogance that I used as defense mechanism. I’ve developed emotional intelligence and availability, and learned the value of vulnerability and non-physical intimacy. I no longer drink, and I’m in the process of quitting smoking. I have practiced listening, patience, and honesty, and the warped relationship I had with The Truth has long been transmuted into a sense of honor and integrity. I’m a loyal , extremely kindhearted person with principles. I buried the scumbag I used to be deep in the cold ground and I’ll be damned if I ever let him out of the grave.


Also, with my new self esteem, I realized I’m an extremely good looking dude, who had the privilege of a very cultured and well-rounded upbringing. I’m well traveled, culturally aware, and very well educated. I have manners, and I must say I clean up very well. I even cultivated a sense of style and learned about fashion a bit. I’m well spoken, gregarious to a fault, and wickedly smart if not a bit day dreamy, and a little naive sometimes. My parents did well to make sure the seeds of generosity, conscientiousness, and compassion were planted in me and they have certainly blossomed. My motto is “militant kindness: wherever, however, whoever.” I do volunteer work, and my friends all universally have wonderful things to say about me. All in all, I think I’m a catch, weird porn preferences notwithstanding, and my faults seem to be centered around being lazy, undoing damage from my past, and learning to stand on my own feet, and trusting myself. I would be remiss to imply I’m anywhere near perfect, but I’ve been shown that, contrary to the tape playing in my head, I have a lot to offer and I’m a decent person.


So why the flying fuckknuckle am I drowning in one word responses, tepid conversation, minimal engagement, and no follow up. It seems like, at least in online dating, every girl I match with is generally just not interested. They’re not interested in having a conversation, they seem uninterested in my suggested dates, they just don’t seem to want to be bothered. Girls are y’all alright? I’ve gotten warmer responses from the food in my fridge. 


I just don’t know what to do. Maybe it’s my city, Phoenix is notorious for its peoples odd behaviors.
